cities.name: Astana
cities.pointBasis: Chosen central-city query point, not a WUP centroid or administrative boundary.
cities.targetGeometryEvidence: Official national PKK egkn:u_view in district_id 254 returned a valid closed MultiPolygon containing the selected point. Nine bounded cells yielded 154 distinct native cadastral keys; all 154 fresh exact-ID geometries matched canonical hashes. The 65 forced short-page requests reproduced the baseline ID set and hashes. Explicit absent-ID probe returned 0; sourceBinding and parcelActBinding each returned exactly one matching parcel. Five measured overlap pairs, all left unchanged, max 0.074380% of smaller parent parcel.
limitations: Esil district 254/local sample only; no citywide completeness claim.
kad_nomer permanence/global uniqueness is undocumented; cadastral reference does not establish title or ownership.
Five tiny measured overlaps were accepted without repair.

cities.name: Bishkek
cities.pointBasis: Chosen central-city query point, not a WUP centroid or administrative boundary.
cities.targetGeometryEvidence: Anonymous public category-filtered center query returned land plots 0889/0890 and selected point is inside 0890. Nine bounded cells yielded 111 unique polygons with repeatable exact-code reads and terminal pagination.
cities.technicalBlocker: Geometry QA holds runtime use: 3/111 geometries are invalid and 12 pairs have positive-area intersections. Adapter implementation exists but is not wired.
limitations: Nine-cell local sample only; citywide completeness is unknown.
PROPCODE permanence/global uniqueness and reuse terms are undocumented.
No runtime adapter acceptance; geometry QA must be resolved first.

cities.name: Dushanbe
cities.pointBasis: Chosen central-city query point, not a WUP centroid or administrative boundary.
cities.technicalBlocker: The official State Geoportal is linked by the registration authority and indexed as a land-parcel map, but its HTTPS certificate was expired; no viewer service or geometry could be verified.
limitations: Official portal existence is documented; public service availability and city coverage are not verified.

cities.name: Tashkent
cities.technicalBlocker: Official Cadastre Agency and Digital Government sources identify the public national geoportal for land-parcel information, but bounded HTTP/HTTPS requests timed out; no service layer or parcel geometry was verified.
limitations: Official portal listing is not evidence that the endpoint was reachable or that target-city geometry is public.

cities.name: Ashgabat
cities.pointBasis: Chosen central-city query point, not a WUP centroid or administrative boundary.
cities.technicalBlocker: Official law confirms the State Land Cadastre and cadastral maps cover Ashgabat and define parcel boundaries, coordinates and unique numbers, but no public viewer, endpoint or geometry was found.
limitations: Legal confirmation of a state cadastre does not establish open access or public geometry; access may be formal or paid.

methodNotes: registryFound/officialRegistryOrPortalFound means documented official registry or portal existence; it does not imply anonymous access or parcel geometry.
A small verified sample is not a citywide completeness claim.
Geometry references do not establish ownership or legal title.
Astana and Bishkek use chosen central-city points rather than WUP centroids; only Astana is configured in the app, scoped to Esil district 254.
Bishkek has a verified public sample but is held from runtime pending invalid-geometry and positive-area-overlap QA.
